notes: Best frames now have to be held, not glitched — the mirror of yesterday's worst-frame fix. The report's top Best frame and the frame sent to AI Photo used to come from the single highest-scoring frame, so one pose misread could show you a 'perfect' rep you never actually held. A high frame only counts once the next frame is high too, and the clip and two-camera 'Looks good here' moments now pick the best held frame instead of a lone spike, so the rep you're told to copy is one you really held.
